summary: Tuesday morning is the prize: Matunuck lights up with a prime SE swell to 3.5ft and offshore dawn — a real drive-worthy day, with Ditch close behind on the same clean cycle. Monday brings short-period size close to home, and Lido's prime angle plus glassy morning makes it the pick over Rockaway, which is good enough if you'd rather not travel. After that it fades to small, clean leftovers into a mushy weekend.
